title.narrative: Advancing effective policies and practices to achieve inclusive development in Namibia through the Implementation of UNESCO Roadmap against Racism and Discrimination

description.narrative: Emerging from colonial domination followed by an apartheid oppression, Namibia pursues its commitment towards the reinforcement of a State based on the rule of law grounded on respect for human rights as well as on regional and global frameworks on these issues. The Activity aims to translate the Roadmap on Anti-Racism and Anti-Discrimination, building a culture of human rights and promote global citizenship, addressing as well pre-existing social inequalities and exclusion exacerbated by Covid19. Partnership will be reinforced with UN sister agencies, government entities and national human rights institutions to promote General History of Africa, Transforming MENtalities and development of National Action Plan for Persons with Albinism.
